title: Eames Lounge Chair
blurb: A moulded plywood and leather armchair from 1956, designed to feel like a well-used baseball mitt.

title: Lava lamp
blurb: Blobs of coloured wax rising and sinking through liquid in a glowing glass vessel, since 1963.

title: Anglepoise lamp
blurb: A desk lamp balanced on springs so that it stays wherever you point it.

title: Moka pot
blurb: The eight-sided aluminium stovetop coffee maker found in nearly every Italian kitchen.

title: Hammock
blurb: A sling of cloth or netting hung between two points, for sleeping, swinging and doing nothing.

title: Rocking chair
blurb: A chair on two curved runners, best placed on a porch.

title: Snow globe
blurb: A glass sphere holding a tiny scene and a flurry of snow that falls when you shake it.

title: Bean bag chair
blurb: A sack of pellets that takes the shape of whoever falls into it.

title: Teapot
blurb: A lidded vessel with a spout and a handle, for steeping tea and settling arguments.

title: Chandelier
blurb: A branched light fixture hung from the ceiling, often dripping with cut glass.

title: Terrarium
blurb: A sealed glass container holding a miniature garden that waters itself.

title: Globe
blurb: A spherical model of the Earth on a tilted axis, made to be spun and stopped with a finger.

title: Music box
blurb: A box that plays a tune when a pinned cylinder plucks the teeth of a steel comb.
